k:HH.Compat.DialogTitle: Hospitality is active alongside Hearth & Harbor. Disable it for you?
k:HH.Compat.DialogBody: Hearth & Harbor replaces Hospitality and its add-ons. While both are active, Hearth & Harbor has switched Hospitality off for this session: its patches, events, buildings and guest tab do nothing. Your Hospitality guest beds and areas are kept and taken over when Hospitality is gone.
k:HH.Compat.DialogMentionHeader: These guest mods stay as they are; their visitors remain theirs:
k:HH.Compat.DialogFailed: The mod list could not be changed automatically ({0}). Please do it by hand:
k:HH.Compat.DialogStep3: 3. Save the mod list and restart the game
k:HH.Compat.ImportLetterText:
This colony was played with Hospitality. Hearth & Harbor took over what it could.

Imported: {0}.
Dropped: {1}.

Imported guest beds are normal beds again and are remembered as guest beds; the guest part of Hearth & Harbor picks them up. Nothing else in your colony changed.
When Hospitality runs alongside Hearth & Harbor, Hearth & Harbor switches it off for the session and offers to disable it in the main menu. On: no more offers (the switch-off still happens).
k:HH.Setting.compat.importLetter: Letter after importing a Hospitality save
k:HH.Setting.compat.importLetter.Desc: After loading a save that was played with Hospitality, a letter lists what Hearth & Harbor took over (guest beds, areas, visitors) and what was dropped.
